title: DependencyEdge
description: One typed edge in an orchestration's task dependency graph (punokawan-14yn.2), from_task_id -> to_task_id meaning from_task_id depends on to_task_id. Only "requires" and "produces-input-for" block execution; "serializes-with" and "informational" are non-blocking. Explicit source/user origins outrank repository-fact, which outranks model-inference. See affiliate-platform-delivery-feedback-2026-08-07.md.

evidence.description: Why this edge exists: an explicit source link, a repository fact, or a model-inference rationale.

removal_evidence.description: Required to remove an edge from a task that has already been routed; not required before routing.

revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency counter; incremented on every applied event.
